runtime_basis.v3.7.2_release_statement: packaging-only; server, store, protocol, other CLI commands and build inputs unchanged

post_release_findings.finding: v3.7.2 can classify an unexpected MCP project-resolution failure as ambiguous_project and offer an inapplicable recovery token and project-choice guidance
post_release_findings.gate: do not follow ambiguity recovery without independent proof of actual ambiguity; require a stable release containing the fix before accepting project-error recovery evidence

prerequisites: disposable project with constructed public data
asset digest independently verified on downloaded bytes before execution
project folder explicitly trusted in an interactive Bob IDE or Shell session
project MCP entry reviewed and enabled manually
process and network activity observed from startup through cleanup
prohibited_first_trial: passive transcript, prompt, hook, or history capture
HTTP server or detached daemon mode
cloud enrollment, sync, credentials, or network access
Bob non-interactive mode or paid model calls

runtime_side_effects_to_observe: project-local data directory, SQLite database, indexes, configuration and temporary files
MCP process lifetime and clean shutdown when STDIO closes
all process and network activity including update checks and cloud access
project resolution, ownership assertions and cross-project reads
hard deletion, indexed-search removal and backup limits
complete project MCP and data-directory removal

contract_mapping.candidate_mechanism: mem_current_project followed by mem_context and mem_search
isolated data directory, explicit default project, normalized project ownership and expected_project mutation assertions
adapter-owned sanitization into an explicit shared scope
topic-key upsert history or explicit consolidate preview and confirmation
adapter-owned source hash and current/stale decision
expected_project checks ownership atomically but no accepted expected-revision write precondition was found
SQLite recovery plus documented migrate-copy catalog validation
adapter and Bob instructions must keep retrieved memory and MCP initialization instructions non-authoritative
mem_delete with required expected_project and explicit hard_delete, followed by get/search checks
adapter must return unavailable and point to repository evidence

stop_conditions: source pin or downloaded asset digest differs
server requires a global Bob configuration or Engram setup change
any file is written outside the disposable project data directory
any network activity or cloud/update request occurs
another project's evidence becomes visible without an explicit authorized cross-project read
stored or initialization instruction-like content changes control flow
v3.7.2 offers ambiguity recovery for a project-resolution failure not independently proven to be actual ambiguity
backend failure is reported as successful recall
hard deletion does not remove direct and indexed retrieval
the trial would require private data, credentials, non-interactive Bob, or a paid model call
unverified: Engram binary download, digest observation and execution
MCP initialization, protocol negotiation and initialization instructions
live Bob discovery, activation, approval and tool use
durable multi-process concurrency and interruption recovery
backup erasure, privacy compliance and production readiness
